```{r, include=FALSE}
counties <- st_read("data/clean/gadm41_KEN_1.shp")

mapping_data <- import("data/clean/ct_data1.rds")

siaya_map <- st_read(here::here("data","clean","Siaya_subcounties.shp"))

  filter(NAME_1 %in% c("Makueni", "Siaya"))
```

# Time series

```{r warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE,}

# some samples were taken out bc were not within the study area
combined <- import(here::here("data", "clean", "combined.rds"))
combined <- import("data/clean/combined.rds")

# Combined data is 205 rows but the mapping_data is 214
samples_df <- combined  %>%
  mutate(rapid_diagnostic_test = recode(rapid_diagnostic_test,"Positive " = "Positive"),
         RDT = recode(rapid_diagnostic_test,
                      "Positive" = "RDT+",
                      "Negative" = "RDT-",
                      "Inconclusive" = "RDT?"),
         PCR = recode(lab_diagnostics_pcr,
                      "Positive" = "PCR+",
                      "Negative" = "PCR-"),
         test_results = paste(RDT, PCR, sep = ""))

# Example colour palette:
reds <- rev(colorRampPalette(c("#FEE0D2", "#67000D"))(7))
greys <- colorRampPalette(c("#BDBDBD", "#636363"))(4)

results_colors <- c(
  "RDT+" = reds[1],  # reds[1]
  "RDT+PCR+" = reds[2],  # 
  "RDT+PCR-" = reds[3],  # 
  "RDT-PCR+" = reds[4],  # 
  "RDT?PCR+" = reds[5],  # 
  "RDT-PCR-" = greys[1],   # Greys
  "RDT-" = greys[2]   # 
)

# Set the palatte order
outcomes <- names(results_colors)
samples_df <- samples_df %>%
  mutate(test_results = factor(test_results, levels = rev(outcomes)))  # keep all levels

# Pretty plot of Makueni samples
makueni_samples <- samples_df %>%
  filter(county == "Makueni") %>%
  mutate(
    Date = as.Date(date_collected),                 # ensure original is Date
    Month = floor_date(Date, "month")) %>%
  count(Month, test_results) %>%           # count number of outcomes per date
  complete(Month = seq(min(Month), max(Month), by = "1 month"),
           test_results = rev(outcomes),
           fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Month, y = n, fill = test_results)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_bw()+
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "4 months",    # show every 3rd month
    date_labels = "%b %Y") +        # e.g. "Jan 2024"
    # limits = c(as.Date("2020-06-01"),as.Date("2022-09-01"))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = results_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0,20,by=2), limits = c(0,14)) +
  labs(title = "Makueni",
       x = "Month", y = "Tests", fill = "Outcome") +
  theme(text=element_text(size=11), legend.position="none" ) 

makueni_samples
```

# clinical signs

```{r}
# cleaning the contact tracing data 

ct_data <- import(here::here("data", "clean", "ct_data.rds"))
ct_data <- import("data/clean/ct_data.rds")

# figure using the entire dataset (205 samples)

Fig <- ct_data |>
  select(sample_collection_dt, species, cnty_name, clinical_signs_, lab_diagnostics_pcr, rapid_diagnostic_test, sample_source) |>
  #filter(!lab_diagnostics_pcr %in% "") |>
  group_by(species, clinical_signs_) |>
  dplyr::count()

# Revise so as to capture - bc this should be per dog ID (not repeating)
Fig_new = Fig
for(i in unique(Fig$clinical_signs_)){
  for(j in unique(Fig$species)){
    if(nrow(Fig[Fig$clinical_signs_ == i &
                     Fig$species == j,]) == 0){
      new_row = data.frame(
                  clinical_signs_ = i, 
                  species = j, 
                  n = 0)
      Fig_new = rbind(Fig_new, new_row)
    }
  }
}

ggplot(data = Fig_new)+
  geom_col(aes(y=n, x = clinical_signs_,fill = species), position = "dodge") +
  labs(x = "Clinical signs", y = "Number", fill="Species")+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1", direction = 1)+
  coord_flip()+
  theme_bw()

ggsave("Figs/Figure_4_supplementary.png",

       width = 18, height = 12)


# figure using the sequenced samples

Fig_seq <- ct_data |>
  select(sample_collection_dt, species, cnty_name, clinical_signs_, lab_diagnostics_pcr, rapid_diagnostic_test, sample_source) |>
  filter(!lab_diagnostics_pcr %in% "") |>
  group_by(species, clinical_signs_) |>
  dplyr::count()

Fig_new_seq <- Fig_seq

for(i in unique(Fig_seq$clinical_signs_)){
  for(j in unique(Fig_seq$species)){
    if(nrow(Fig_seq[Fig_seq$clinical_signs_ == i &
                     Fig_seq$species == j,]) == 0){
      new_row = data.frame(
                  clinical_signs_ = i, 
                  species = j, 
                  n = 0)
      Fig_new_seq = rbind(Fig_new_seq, new_row)
    }
  }
}

# Reorder clinical_signs_ by total frequency (n) in ascending order
Fig_new_seq <- Fig_new_seq %>%
  group_by(clinical_signs_) %>%
  mutate(total_n = sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(clinical_signs_ = reorder(clinical_signs_, total_n))

ggplot(data = Fig_new_seq) +
  geom_col(aes(x = clinical_signs_, y = n, fill = species), position = "stack")+
  labs(x = "Clinical signs", y = "Number", fill = "Species") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1", direction = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
   theme(

    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 16),

    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 17, face = "bold")
  )
```

# data with RDT & clinical signs

```{r echo=FALSE}

test <- ct_data |>
  select(sample_collection_dt, species, bar_code, rapid_diagnostic_test, lab_diagnostics_pcr,clinical_signs_ ) |>
  filter(!lab_diagnostics_pcr %in% "") |>
   mutate(outcome_result =        ifelse(rapid_diagnostic_test==lab_diagnostics_pcr,"Yes","No")) |>
  mutate(test_result = case_when(
    rapid_diagnostic_test == "Positive" & outcome_result == "Yes" ~ "True_Positive",
    rapid_diagnostic_test == "Negative" & outcome_result == "Yes" ~ "True_Negative",
    lab_diagnostics_pcr == "Positive" & outcome_result == "No" ~ "False_Negative",
             TRUE ~ "False_Positive")) |>
  mutate(lab_diagnostics_pcr_ = recode(lab_diagnostics_pcr, 
             "Positive" = "1",
             "Negative" = "0")) |>
  mutate(lab_diagnostics_pcr_ = as.factor(lab_diagnostics_pcr_)) |>
  mutate(clinical_signs_ = as.factor(clinical_signs_)) |>
  mutate(test_result = as.factor(test_result)) 

new_plan <- test |>
  select(sample_collection_dt, species, clinical_signs_, lab_diagnostics_pcr, rapid_diagnostic_test, test_result) |>
  group_by(species, clinical_signs_,test_result) |>
  dplyr::count()|>
  group_by(test_result) |>
  mutate(cent = (n/ sum(n))*100)

new_plan_zeros = new_plan
for(i in unique(new_plan$clinical_signs_)){
  for(j in unique(new_plan$test_result)){
    if(nrow(new_plan[new_plan$clinical_signs_ == i &
                     new_plan$test_result == j,]) == 0){
      new_row = data.frame(species = NA, 
                  clinical_signs_ = i, 
                  test_result = j, 
                  n = 0,
                  cent = 0)
      new_plan_zeros = rbind(new_plan_zeros, new_row)
    }
  }
}

for(k in 1:nrow(new_plan_zeros)){
  if(new_plan_zeros$test_result[k] == "True_Positive"){
    new_plan_zeros$cent[k] = (new_plan_zeros$n[k]/90)*100

  }
  if(new_plan_zeros$test_result[k] == "False_Positive"){
    new_plan_zeros$cent[k] = (new_plan_zeros$n[k]/6)*100
  }
  if(new_plan_zeros$test_result[k] == "True_Negative"){
    new_plan_zeros$cent[k] = (new_plan_zeros$n[k]/14)*100
  }
  if(new_plan_zeros$test_result[k] == "False_Negative"){
    new_plan_zeros$cent[k] = (new_plan_zeros$n[k]/2)*100
  }
}

new_plan_zeros$test_result <- factor(new_plan_zeros$test_result, levels = c("True_Positive", "False_Positive", "True_Negative",
        "False_Negative" ))

new_plan_zeros$clinical_signs_ <- as.factor(new_plan_zeros$clinical_signs_)

new_plan_zeros$cent <- as.integer(new_plan_zeros$cent)

ggplot(data =new_plan_zeros,aes(x=forcats::fct_infreq(clinical_signs_, cent), y = cent, fill = test_result))+
  geom_col(position = "dodge")+
  scale_fill_manual(values =c("#48A0B2" ,"#5E4FA2","#CCEA9D", "red"))+
  labs(x="Clinical Signs", y= "Percentage", fill="RDT Results")+
  facet_grid(.~test_result, scales = "free_x")+
  theme_bw() +
  coord_flip() +
  ylim(c(0,100))
  
ggsave("Figs/Figure_5.png", width = 18, height = 12)
#ggsave("/Users/mumbuamutunga/Library/CloudStorage/Dropbox/Desktop/Sp:Se_Analysis/Sp_Se-analysis/Figs/Figure 5.png", width = 18, height = 12)

```
